MOD_DC_BTN_JOIN.title: Join Server
MOD_DC_BTN_JOIN.description: Connect to a custom server via IP address.
MOD_DC_FAQ_Q1: Q1: Why was I kicked out of the room?
MOD_DC_FAQ_A1: A: This is usually because your Player ID is identical to the host's. Please change your ID to a new set of random numbers in the profile settings.
MOD_DC_FAQ_Q2: Q2: Why am I getting an [InternalNetwork] error?
MOD_DC_FAQ_A2: A: Mod versions might be mismatched. Ensure both players have the exact same version of the DirectConnectIP mod installed, or update to the latest version.
MOD_DC_FAQ_Q3: Q3: I encountered other network errors like [Unknown Error], what should I do?
MOD_DC_FAQ_A3: A: First, check your network stability. If both your network and ID are fine, please contact the author and provide the logs.
MOD_DC_FAQ_Q4: Q4: Why am I getting a [Connection Timeout]?
MOD_DC_FAQ_A4: A: Ensure the host has opened local port 33771 with UDP protocol, and check if the client's network is stable.
MOD_DC_FAQ_A5: A: Absolutely. Just make sure the game version and mod version are identical, and that network communication is normal.
MOD_DC_FAQ_Q6: Q6: None of these solved my problem, how can I get help?
MOD_DC_FAQ_A6: A: You can follow our video channel for contact info. Feel free to reach out for help or feedback anytime.

MOD_DC_PROFILE_WARNING:
Warning: Do not change your ID casually!
It acts as the unique identifier for your saves. Changing it mid-game will result in failed save loading or inability to reconnect!
MOD_DC_ERR_ID_COLLISION_DESC:
Your Player ID is identical to someone in the room!

Please go to your profile settings and change your Player ID to a different set of numbers before trying again.
